title: 5.3.2 Apple Catcher — Worked Example
description: Catch falling apples with a basket. Learn overlap detection and per-frame spawning.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: Use arrow keys to move the basket. Every apple you catch increments the score.
hints: The basket is kinematic — moves with keys, not gravity.

steps.title: Speed up over time
steps.instructions: Make the spawn rate increase as the game progresses — e.g., every 5 seconds drop the spawn interval.
hints: Use frameCount % spawnInterval === 0, then decrement spawnInterval periodically.

steps.title: Add rocks
steps.instructions: A second Group. Overlapping a rock costs a life.
hints: Give rocks a gray color and slightly slower fall.

steps.title: Style the HUD
steps.instructions: Change the text color, add a lives counter, anything that makes it feel like a game.
hints: fill() sets the text color; textSize() sets the size.
